item.title: Verify a rehearsal kit
item.context_text: Your theatre group has reserved props for a rehearsal. The box contains less than the reservation lists, and the storeroom will close soon.
item.objective_text: Explain the gap and arrange a workable handover for a substitute.
success_conditions: Explain the gap and arrange a workable handover for a substitute.

children.title: Read the situation
children.instructions: Read the information and answer both questions.
children.prompt_text:
PROPS RESERVATION
Box R should contain two lamps and a blue cloth. The label says one lamp was sent for repair. A similar lamp can be borrowed from Box H if a staff member signs it out. The storeroom closes at 17:30. The substitute must be returned there by noon tomorrow. Your rehearsal starts at 18:00.

questions.prompt: How can the group get a second lamp?
options: Buy a new lamp before rehearsal
Ask staff to sign a lamp out of Box H
Collect the repaired lamp at noon tomorrow
questions.explanation: The substitute may be borrowed only through staff.

questions.prompt: Which deadline is for returning the substitute?
questions.explanation: The noon deadline is for the return.

children.title: Ask the prop desk for a substitute
children.prompt_text: Props desk: What is missing and when do you need it?
children.instructions: Identify the box and missing item, then request the suggested substitute before closing.
children.model_answer: Hello, Box R only has one lamp. Could a staff member sign out the substitute lamp from Box H for our group? I can collect it before 17:30 and return it by noon tomorrow.

points.label: Ask for a lamp from H

children.title: Brief the volunteer who will return it
children.prompt_text: Volunteer: I've got the lamp. What do I do with it tomorrow?
children.instructions: Give the return time and place, and say what to tell the desk.
children.model_answer: Please take it back to the storeroom before noon tomorrow. Tell the desk it's the substitute lamp for Box H and ask them to mark it returned.
